title: Rap Gesture Picks
heading: Pick the gesturing for each rap shot
intro: Five examples, as asked: the same shot (m12, under the flyover) from the same start frame, once in each of the five prompt patterns from today's web research, each written by its own sealed writer. "now" is the clip in camping song 2 beat 2 (the terrible gesturing). T1 handheld UK freestyle, T2 lens pushed into his face, T3 still camera and understated, T4 a mate filming on a phone, T5 one timed gesture per two seconds. s01 also has a T1 take. Pick the pattern you want (or none, with a note) and it gets written for all 13 shots.

groups.title: m12: night, under a concrete road flyover in London
groups.line: "Once again, and you catching my eye, and you looking to decide in shame, but why now?"

groups.title: s01: night, a narrow London brick alley with wheelie bins and a wall vent
groups.line: "Once again, and you catching my eye ... but why now?"
